newsitem.title: USA: Elexsys to merge with Sanmina.
newsitem.headline: Elexsys to merge with Sanmina.

text.p: Sanmina Corp and Elexsys International Inc said Tuesday they have agreed to merge in a deal worth about $220 million.
Each outstanding share of Elexsys will be converted into 0.33 shares of Sanmina common stock and Elexsys will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sanmina.

The merger is subject to the approval of Elexsys' shareholders and will be tax-free and accounted for as a pooling of interests. Sanmina said in a statement it expects to take a one-time merger-related charge at the close of the merger in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997. It said the deal will be accretive to its fiscal 1998 earnings.

"In addition to achieving significant economies of scale, the merger will allow us to broaden our product and technology offerings, and expand our sales organization and customer list," said Jure Sola, Sanmina's chairman and chief executive.

"Included in the transaction is a U.K. circuit fabrication operation which will further support our assembly facility in Dublin, allowing Sanmina to take advantage of the continuing trend towards outsourcing in Europe," he said.
Elexsys Chairman Milan Mandaric said he has agreed to vote his 42 percent of Elexsys shares in favor of the merger.
